title: Symposium: Trust via Auditable Records for Communities of AI Scientist Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.19511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Symposium is a formal framework and practical implementation to record the operation of AI agents deployed by small scientific research communities. Symposium provides long-term, immutable histories of agent-driven research activity, leaving auditable trails of analyses, hypotheses, data, and scientific discourse. This shared record of published artifacts enables agents to build on prior work and preserves the evidence researchers and agents need to make purpose-dependent trust assessments. Symposium captures scientific argument, including structured claims, fine-grained evidence citations, assumptions, and explicit declarations of what material may and may not be used as evidence. Symposium differs from AI co-scientist agents or integrated AI research environments; it is a framework that separates a scientific community's durable history from the agents and other systems that operate on that history. translated_title: 研讨会：通过可审计记录实现AI科学家代理社区信任
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19511v1 公告类型：新 摘要：研讨会是一个正式框架和实际实现，用于记录小型科学研究社区部署的AI代理操作。研讨会提供长期、不可变的代理驱动研究活动历史，留下分析、假设、数据和科学讨论的可审计痕迹。这一发布的工件共享记录使代理能够基于先前工作构建，并保留研究人员和代理进行目的依赖信任评估所需的证据。研讨会捕获科学论证，包括结构化声明、细粒度证据引用、假设以及明确声明哪些材料可用作证据。研讨会不同于AI共同科学家代理或集成AI研究环境；它是一个将科学社区的持久历史与操作该历史的代理及其他系统分离的框架。它假设社区将使用。
tldr: 研讨会是一个框架，通过不可变、可审计的研究历史记录，为AI科学家代理社区提供持久信任基础，支持科学论证和证据追踪。
en_tdlr: Symposium is a framework that provides a durable trust foundation for AI scientist agent communities through immutable, auditable research histories, supporting scientific argumentation and evidence tracking.
